note: Survival mode's numbers (spec section 7). Built so far: `map`, the path map of a stage (rules 1.40; spec rules 7 to 12; build step 2); the run's start, the encounter generator, the fights' rewards and the node panels (rules 1.41; spec rules 2, 5, 13 to 24, 26; build step 3). The other keys of section 7 are added by the later build steps. Every number is provisional.

run.about: Rules 1.41 (spec rules 2, 5, 10): the credits each character starts a run with, the HP a character dead in a won fight comes back at, the first stage's setting.

stage.about: Rules 1.41 (spec rule 19, sections 5.4 and 11.1): what a stage multiplies. Stage s: the bulk target x (1 + bulk x (s - 1)), the pressure cap x (1 + pressure x (s - 1)), credits x (1 + credits x (s - 1)), XP x xp[s - 1] (the last repeats); Elites and Bosses stand min((s - 1) x elite_up.per, elite_up.max) levels above the fight level. Step 3 plays stage 1, where every term is 1.

rounds.about: Rules 1.41 (spec rule 17): the target rounds R of a fight by node kind; a plain fight at depth early_depth or less is fight_early.

tiers.about: Rules 1.41 (spec rule 16, section 5.1): each tier's bulk (rifle-turns to remove it over a Soldier's) and pressure (Soldier-turns it deals a round) at equal level, in Soldier-equivalents (SE).

share.about: Rules 1.41 (spec rule 20): an Elite or a Boss spawns scaled by the party's size N (index N - 1): its HP and its damage; it costs its bulk x hp and its pressure x damage.

map_size.about: Rules 1.41 (spec rule 22): the fight's map by its units (the party and the foes): up to `units`, a square of `size` tiles cropped from the middle of the open ground; the squad starts in the columns `squad_cols` (the west edge).

xp.about: Rules 1.41 (spec section 3.1): f(d) = base + per_depth x (d - 1) to each character; an Elite x elite, the Boss x boss, a cache x cache.

credits.about: Rules 1.41 (spec section 3.1): c(d) = base + per_depth x d to each character; an Elite x elite, the Boss x boss, a cache x cache.

ammo_pack.about: Rules 1.41 (spec rule 23): after a won fight (or at a cache) each character gets this many magazines' worth of rounds for every gun it carries, and `cores` standard cores if it carries a focus of a kind in `core_doors`.

rewards.about: Rules 1.41 (spec rule 26): the weapon pick of `offer` weapons after a won fight, the first for the character's own door or weapon category; rarity by node kind, capped by `ceiling` (by stage, the last repeats); price at most base + per_depth x d + per_stage x (s - 1), x elite or boss; or credits instead, instead_rate of the cheapest offer's price.

nodes.about: Rules 1.41: what each kind of node without a fight says on its panel. Until build steps 4 and 4a the shop, Forge, training ground, shrine and Crossroads only say what will be here, and the party moves on.
nodes.shop: A shop will stand here: every calibre always in stock, rolled gear, selling, the grade step and gives between players. It opens with the next build step.
nodes.forge: A Forge will stand here: the grade step for less, the Relic step, mods and worn pieces, armour fitting. It opens with a later build step.
nodes.training: A training ground will stand here: one big training each (drill, study or practice), and a second for credits. It opens with a later build step.
nodes.shrine: A shrine will stand here: a rite for Devotion, a knowledge piece, or the patron's token. It opens with a later build step.
nodes.event: A crossroads will stand here: one trade for each of you, or walk on. It opens with a later build step.
nodes.cache: A cache: credits, ammunition and a little experience. Its armour-or-item pick opens with a later build step.
nodes.rest: A safe place: everyone is healed in full and a new session begins. The small training at a rest opens with a later build step.

pools.about: Rules 1.41 (spec rule 21 e): the weapons a foe of a tier may carry, by range (a slot names `ranged`, `melee` or `close`; none: ranged). A setting may name its own in place of these.

names.about: Rules 1.41: a foe's name by its kind and tier (numbered in a fight when there are two). In-world words only.
